name: Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior
description: Detection, conceptualization and typology of coordinated link sharing and inauthentic network behaviour on social media platforms. Central research signature of the PI, anchoring CooRnet, vera.ai WP4, and multiple election studies.

name: Information Disorder and Disinformation Narratives
description: Study of misleading information, fake news taxonomies, problematic content circulation and disinformation narratives across hybrid media systems, including health, war and electoral contexts. Umbrella theme for MINE, PROMPT and vera.ai.

name: Elections and Political Communication
description: Empirical analysis of political campaigns, partisan attention, hyperpartisan networks and news coverage around Italian, German, Brazilian and European elections. Core MINE research line since 2017.

name: Platform Governance, APIs and the DSA Era
description: Research on platform policies, data access regimes, algorithmic governance and content moderation — from CrowdTangle's shutdown to Meta's political content reduction and the Digital Services Act. Increasingly prominent in the current agenda.

name: Generative AI and Media
description: Uses and challenges of generative AI in media production, disinformation (synthetic imagery, coordinated gambling promotion) and in scholarly practice. Directly tied to the Master's course on Generative AI and Media and to recent publications.

name: LLMs and Computational Methods for Communication Research
description: Methodological work on integrating large language models, embeddings and human-in-the-loop pipelines for text classification, annotation and clustering of political discourse. Growing methodological thread across 2024–2026 outputs.

name: Social Media Analytics and Digital Methods
description: Tools, workflows and methodological reflections for collecting and analysing social media data — including CooRnet, digital traces for survey recruitment, and computational social science more broadly.

name: Polarization and Partisan Media Ecosystems
description: Analysis of insularity, cross-partisanship, alternative influence networks and the amplification of extremes across traditional and social media. Long-running theme from the 2018 Italian election through recent handbook chapters.

name: Health Misinformation and Public Debate
description: Coordinated circulation of problematic health content, COVID-19 fact-checking, and post-truth dynamics around medicine and vaccines. Anchored in MINE-FACTS and the India/Nigeria Gates Foundation project.

name: Internet Studies and Sociocybernetics
description: Theoretical foundations connecting systems theory, sociocybernetics and internet studies — the PI's long-standing conceptual backbone, still reflected in teaching and occasional theoretical contributions.

name: Audience Engagement, Virality and Social TV
description: Studies of second-screen practices, viral content dynamics and audience participation across TV, Facebook and Instagram. Recurring theme from the social TV works through the 2025 book *Viralità*.

name: Platforms, Audiences, and Online Communities
description: Empirical and reflective studies of how platform affordances, cultures, and audience practices shape online sociality, identity, and community formation across sites like Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/Mastodon, and LiveJournal.
